evidence_families.head: bb9cc037ce6497d9979bfdc6003ede49b27824a4
positive_update: The live mapped libsqlite object is bound by realpath, GNU build-id, SHA-256 and package identity.
Ten multi-process SIGKILL cycles over WAL at NORMAL and FULL recorded 12807 fsynced post-commit receipts with zero observed loss, zero classified phantoms, integrity ok and post-crash writability.
Three measurement-instrument defects were preserved as negative results.
limits_and_counterevidence: The fsynced log is written after COMMIT returns, so it observes durable post-commit receipts, not every COMMIT-return event in the kill-to-log window.
SQLite primary documentation states transactions are durable across application crashes; the run is valuable exact-object regression evidence but not a surprising discriminator.
The general SIGKILL oracle cannot decide WAL-reset fix presence. SQLite states the race was not reproduced organically and required special source instrumentation to force the schedule.
No power-loss, kernel-panic, VFS fault, filesystem/device flush, or targeted WAL-reset discriminator ran.

sources.claim: SQLite distinguishes application crash from operating-system crash/power loss; application-crash durability holds regardless of synchronous mode, while WAL NORMAL can lose recent transactions after power loss/system crash.
The WAL-reset race affects concurrent WAL writers/checkpoints and was only reproduced using special test-control instrumentation; organic stress alone is not a decisive fix-presence test.
SQLite 3.53.4 dated 2026-07-24 carries the WAL-reset fix lineage.
The 2025 preregistered adversarial GNWT/IIT study found mixed results and substantially challenged key tenets; software broadcast/control completion must not be promoted to consciousness evidence.

concepts.hypothesis: A GWT-to-effect re-entry is causally bound only if the database or a verified typed receipt links episode identity, selected content digest, broadcast identity and receiver-use witness to the exact outcome and admitted delta; non-empty strings are provenance shape, not causal truth.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Application-level generation of these identifiers is sufficient because the V17 database only owns terminal effect integrity, not workspace semantics.
decisive_test: On the current PR312 bytes, replace episode_id, signal_id and causal_id with never-created non-empty values and provenance with an unrelated non-empty dictionary.
If REENTERED/DONE still succeeds, classify current V17 as EFFECT_OUTCOME_BOUND_PLUS_SELF_ATTESTED_COGNITIVE_LINK.
Add an admitted WorkspaceEpisode/ReceiverUse receipt domain and require FK or verified typed-root membership; rerun the swap and require schema-level refusal.
Lesion selected-content or receiver-use while retaining identifiers; require downstream causal credit and learning admission to fail.

concepts.hypothesis: Stored information and used information are separate axes. A re-entry channel is content-bearing only when at least two distinct admitted deltas induce preregistered distinguishable downstream state or action under matched conditions.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Presence of any verified delta is the intended sufficient statistic for this minimal slice; Boolean consumption is not a defect if labeled honestly.
concepts.current_static_result: PR312 maps every non-empty last_admitted_delta to the same +0.1 pressure change, so current downstream information rank is one presence bit, not delta-content use.
decisive_test: Run matched turns with delta A, delta B and no delta while keeping all other bytes fixed.
Require A versus B to differ at a declared consumer if CONTENT_PATH is claimed; otherwise relabel as VERIFIED_REENTRY_PRESENCE.
Measure intervention rank over memory, candidate ordering, selected action and terminal outcome rather than only storage cardinality.

concepts.hypothesis: Clay semantic confidence requires agreement among exact-source execution, the shipping Python reference and a separately derived declarative policy oracle or exhaustive symbolic partition; two shared-spec implementations can agree on the same mistake.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Targeted semantic mutation adequacy plus branch-structured random differential testing is sufficient for the current narrow policy.
decisive_test: Derive a policy truth table or SMT/BDD model from owner-reviewed requirements, not from either implementation.

concepts.hypothesis: Evaluator admission must fail whenever analysis.diagnostics is non-empty, before reachability or execution, because ambiguous nominal variants invalidate constructor identity globally.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Only diagnostics reachable from the admitted function should block; global rejection would unnecessarily prevent isolated valid functions.
concepts.static_falsifier: Analyzer marks duplicate sum variants as `<AMBIGUOUS>` in diagnostics, but Evaluator.admit does not inspect diagnostics.
decisive_test: Create two sum types sharing variant ALLOW and a function returning ALLOW.
Current prediction: admit succeeds and returns EnumValue(`<AMBIGUOUS>`, `ALLOW`).
Require either global fail-closed rejection or a proven reachable-diagnostic slice; add negative receipt and mutation test.

concepts.hypothesis: Fix-presence promotion for the SQLite WAL-reset race requires a paired discriminator that fails on a known-vulnerable build and passes on a fixed build under the same forced schedule and build flags; untargeted crash stress cannot close axis C.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Source-hook instrumentation perturbs the race, so only long organic stress is externally valid.
concepts.synthesis: Use two non-substitutable lanes: deterministic upstream-style forced-schedule discrimination for internal validity, plus uninjected long-run stress for operational validity.
decisive_test: Build vulnerable and fixed source siblings with identical options and upstream test-control hook.
Force the documented writer/checkpoint interleaving and require corruption/omission only on the vulnerable sibling.
Bind each loaded object by build-id/SHA/source-id and preserve negative results.
Only then compare the private 3.53.4 build and the Ubuntu object; do not infer axis C from general SIGKILL passes.
